en: Do you know two little words that make people love each other?
Our beloved Prophet, Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam, said:
Shall I tell you something that, if you do it, you will love one another?
So when you see your friend, say: Assalamu Alaikum!
It means: peace be upon you.
And when someone says it to you, answer: Wa Alaikum Assalam!
Say it at home, at school, and at the masjid.
Who will you say salam to first today?
